camel_example: aliyun dts CreateSynchronizationJob --region cn-hangzhou --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --PayType PostPaid --SourceRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --SynchronizationJobClass small --DestRegion 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Creates a legacy data synchronization job instance
description_zh: 老版创建一个数据同步作业实例
kebab_example: aliyun dts create-synchronization-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --source-region cn-hangzhou --dest-region cn-hangzhou --synchronization-job-class small --pay-type PostPaid --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSynchronizationJob

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the data synchronization instance. The value must be the same as the value of the DestRegion parameter
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例地域的ID，与DestRegion参数保持一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the source database. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步的源数据库所属地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the destination database. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html.
If the region specified by the SourceRegion parameter is Hong Kong (China) or outside China, you must specify the same region ID for this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
数据同步的目标数据库所属地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html。
如果SourceRegion参数传入的地域为中国香港或海外地区，那么本参数须传入相同地域的ID
parameters.name: dest_region

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization topology. Valid values:

oneway: one-way synchronization.
bidirectional: two-way synchronization.

Default value: oneway.
You can set this parameter to bidirectional only when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType and DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType parameters are set to MySQL, PolarDB, or Redis
parameters.help_zh:
同步拓扑，取值：

oneway：单向同步
bidirectional：双向同步。

默认取值为oneway。
当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType和DestinationEndpoint.InstanceType参数取值为MySQL、PolarDB或Redis时，本参数才可以传入bidirectional
parameters.name: topology

parameters.help_en:
The specifications of the data synchronization link. Valid values: micro, small, medium, and large.
For more information about the specifications and performance tests of data synchronization links, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.help_zh:
数据同步链路的规格，取值：micro、small、medium、large。
关于各链路规格的说明及性能测试情况请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26605.html
parameters.name: synchronization_job_class

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

PrePaid: upfront.
PostPaid: pay-as-you-go. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。

PrePaid：预付费。
PostPaid：按量付费，默认付费类型
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the upfront instance. Valid values:

Year: yearly.
Month: monthly.

This parameter is valid and required only when the PayType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例的计费方式，取值：

Year：包年。
Month：包月。

当付费类型为PrePaid（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the upfront instance.

When the billing method is set to Year (yearly), valid values are 1 to 5.
When the billing method is set to Month (monthly), valid values are 1 to 60.

This parameter is valid and required only when the PayType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
预付费实例购买时长。

当计费方式为Year（包年）时，取值范围为1~5。
当计费方式为Month（包月）时，取值范围为1~60。

当付费类型为PrePaid（预付费）时，该参数才有效且必须传入
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the source database. Valid values:

MySQL: MySQL databases, including ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances and self-managed MySQL databases.
PolarDB: PolarDB clusters (only MySQL or engines compatible with Oracle syntax are supported).
Redis: Redis databases.
DRDS: cloud-native distributed database PolarDB-X 1.0.

Default value: MySQL.
For more information about the supported source and destination databases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130744.html
parameters.help_zh:
源库的实例类型，取值：

MySQL：MySQL数据库（包括RDS MySQL和自建MySQL）。
PolarDB：PolarDB集群（仅支持MySQL或兼容Oracle语法的引擎）。
Redis：Redis数据库。
DRDS：云原生分布式数据库PolarDB-X 1.0。

默认取值为MySQL。
关于支持的源库和目标库对应情况，请参见支持的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130744.html
parameters.name: source_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the destination database. Valid values:
MySQL: MySQL databases, including ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances and self-managed MySQL databases.
PolarDB: PolarDB clusters (only MySQL or engines compatible with Oracle syntax are supported).
Redis: Redis databases.
MaxCompute: MaxCompute instances.

Default value: MySQL.
For more information about the supported source and destination databases, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130744.html
parameters.help_zh:
目标库的实例类型，取值：
MySQL：MySQL数据库（包括RDS MySQL和自建MySQL）。
PolarDB：PolarDB集群（仅支持MySQL或兼容Oracle语法的引擎）。
Redis：Redis数据库。
MaxCompute：MaxCompute实例。

默认取值为MySQL。
关于支持的源库和目标库对应情况，请参见支持的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/130744.html
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The network type of Data Transmission Service. The value is fixed to Intranet (Express Connect circuit)
parameters.help_zh: 数据传输网络类型，固定取值为Intranet（专线）
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated soon
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en: The number of private custom ApsaraDB RDS instances attached to the source PolarDB-X instance. This parameter is required only when the SourceEndpoint.InstanceType parameter is set to DRDS. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当SourceEndpoint.InstanceType传入DRDS时，您需要传入本参数来指定源PolarDB-X下挂的私有定制RDS实例数量，默认值为1
parameters.name: db_instance_count

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用出错时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回对应的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The request processing has failed due to some unknown error.

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
